---
title: "multivariable analyses for ppi and h2b"
author: "Anna Petouhoff"
date: "2026-01-23"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
```

```{r}
CoRR <- read.csv("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/ppiio/data/derived/2025-02-17/CoRR_formatted.csv") %>%
  select("ppi", "abx_iostart", "staging", "cci_number", "days", "vitalstatus", "chemo_greater_one_year", "h2b_iostart")
```

```{r}
ppi_abx <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi +  abx_iostart, data = CoRR)
summary(ppi_abx)

ppi_staging <-coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi +  staging, data = CoRR)
summary(ppi_staging)

ppi_cci <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi +  cci_number, data = CoRR)
summary(ppi_cci)
```

```{r}
# extract results from each model 
res1 <- tidy(ppi_abx, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "PPI, controlling for Abx")
res2 <- tidy(ppi_staging, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "PPI, controlling for Staging")
res3 <- tidy(ppi_cci, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "PPI, controlling for CCI")

# combine the results 
all_res <- bind_rows(res1, res2, res3)

# filter to show only the PPI row
ppi_only <- all_res %>%
  filter(term == "ppi") %>%
  mutate(p_label = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p.value, 3))))

ppi_fp <- ggplot(ppi_only, aes(x = estimate, y = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, color = "slateblue") +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, color = "slateblue4") +
  # p-values: adjusted hjust to prevent overlap with the error bar end
  geom_text(aes(label = p_label, x = conf.high), 
            hjust = -0.1, vjust = 0.5, size = 4) + 
  # Increased the right-side expansion (0.6) to make room for text
  scale_x_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.6))) + 
  labs(x = "Hazard Ratio (Log Scale)", 
       y = "",
       title = "PPI Impact on Survival Across Bivariate Models") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10), # Extra right margin
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("../figures/Figure2F.svg", plot = ppi_fp, device = "svg", width = 6, height = 3)
```



```{r}
h2b_abx <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart + abx_iostart, data = CoRR)
summary(h2b_abx)

h2b_staging <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart + staging, data = CoRR)
summary(h2b_staging)

h2b_cci <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ h2b_iostart + cci_number, data = CoRR)
summary(h2b_cci)
```

```{r}
# extract results from each model 
res4 <- tidy(h2b_abx, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "H2B, controlling for Abx")
res5 <- tidy(h2b_staging, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "H2B, controlling for Staging")
res6 <- tidy(h2b_cci, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "H2B, controling for CCI")

# combine the results 
all_res2 <- bind_rows(res4, res5, res6)

# filter to show only the PPI row
h2b_only <- all_res2 %>%
  filter(term == "h2b_iostart") %>%
  mutate(p_label = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p.value, 3))))

# create a forest plot
h2b_fp <- ggplot(h2b_only, aes(x = estimate, y = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, color = "slateblue") +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, color = "slateblue4") +
  # Add the p-value text
  geom_text(aes(label = p_label, x = conf.high), 
            hjust = -0.2, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  # Expand the x-axis slightly so the text doesn't get cut off
  scale_x_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.4))) + 
  labs(x = "Hazard Ratio (Log Scale)", 
       y = "",
       title = "H2B Impact on Survival Across Bivariate Models") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size =11, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

h2b_fp

ggsave("../figures/Figure2G.svg", plot = h2b_fp, device = "svg", width = 6, height = 3)
```
